notes: Finding: the firmware's single-threshold brake guard reads the pack on the fused side of the contactor, and braking lifts that reading 0.26 V, so it flipped brake/coast every 10 ms tick (126 flips per 20% slow-down in the model, 21 on the simulated board running the real firmware) for packs resting 27.19-27.78 V. Fixed with controller.BrakeGuard and REGEN_BRAKE_HYST_MV=700 (model needs >=597 mV). Bounce trains (1-10 opens): idle worst make 19.3 A = precharge closing; with stepper enabled early 32.1 A vs the one-bounce model's 24.9 A (that model was optimistic), still under 60 A. All figures assumed; nothing built. Verification (local, build123d 0.13.0 venv): cad/tests 120 passed in 445 s; tests/ 105 passed + 39 subtests (one earlier run had 1 failure because it overlapped the package regeneration; rerun clean); node platform/pages/venture-preflight.mjs open-tennis-robots: preflight clean; feeder package regenerated, design_rules [] and collisions []; promptctl validate ok.
